services.name: view charters
services.desc: Our Back Bay Fishing trips are really a blast! Novices and pros alike rave about this unique Florida Salt Water Fishing experience, sometimes referred to as Flats Fishing. Back Bay boats are capable of operating in very shallow water in order to go right where the fish are! Fish for Snook, Tarpon, Redfish, Sea Trout, Cobia and Shark. The Tarpon run strong in Tampa Bay from May through early September, throughout Boca Ciega Bay Florida and surrounding Tampa Bay waters. There are numerous other species that can also be pursued using Fly rods in our area. Each vessel carries 1 to 4 guests and all your fishing gear is included. services.name: Sunset Trips
services.desc: Since 1972, hundreds of couples have sailed out to Boca Ciega Bay and taken their vows aboard our beautiful ocean yachts. Dolphin Landings offers pure romance on large luxury sailboats and spacious motor yachts. Whether you are planning a small and intimate occation or a lavish celebration, Dolphin Landings Charter Boat Center will tend to you and your guests every need. How about a romantic Island wedding a sunrise or sunset for just the two of you? Have a big wedding in mind? No problem we can provide 3 sailing yachts which can cover you entire party. services.name: Dolphin Watching
services.desc: Our captains can confidently tell guests they have a 99% chance they will see dolphins from our vessels. Are they that good? Well, yes … but they also know the deck is stacked in their favor. Boca Ciega Bay and the greater Tampa Bay area is home to over 700 healthy identified dolphins. Guests never tire of seeing them swimming along in their natural habitat. If you’re lucky, you may see them jump completely out of the water , After all, they like to look at you too! While guests occasionally spot dolphins just beyond our docks, the best way to truly experience the natural wonder of these wild sea creatures is on board one of our luxury sailing yachts and glide silently among them.
